<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="wnT8MxMKIMsKyE7kEwrZ"> <mxGraphModel dx="6316" dy="3180" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Styling definitions
 classDef userspaceClass fill:#dae8fc,stroke:#6c8ebf,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef coreClass fill:#fff2cc,stroke:#d6b656,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef lowlevelClass fill:#f8cecc,stroke:#b85450,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef archClass fill:#d5e8d4,stroke:#82b366,stroke-width:2px;

 %% --- USERSPACE BOUNDARY ---
 subgraph USERSPACE [\"Userspace Boundary\"]
 NPTL[\"<b>NPTL glibc</b><br/>• pthread_create()<br/>• Issues clone() / clone3() syscall<br/>• Passes kernel_clone_args to kernel\"]:::userspaceClass
 AFFINITY_SYS[\"<b>CPU Affinity Syscall</b><br/>• sched_setaffinity()<br/>• Separate userspace entry point<br/>• Bypasses thread-creation path entirely\"]:::userspaceClass
 end

 %% --- KERNEL INTERFACES & HOOKS ---
 subgraph KERNEL_CORE [\"Kernel Interfaces & Hooks\"]
 CORE[\"<b>MultiThreading Core</b><br/>• task_struct — include/linux/sched.h<br/>• Lifecycle & thread group management<br/>• copy_process() — linux/kernel/fork.c<br/>• kthread_create_on_node() — linux/kernel/kthread.c<br/>• kthreadd (PID 2) — linux/kernel/kthread.c<br/>• kthread() — linux/kernel/kthread.c<br/>• kernel/exit.c — thread teardown<br/>• Thread-local storage (TLS)<br/>• copy_mm() — clones / shares mm_struct\"]:::coreClass
 
 SIGNAL[\"<b>Signal Subsystem</b> [kernel/signal.c]<br/>• Interprets clone flags<br/>• Signals to singular / group threads<br/>• Called by copy_process()\"]:::coreClass
 
 FUTEX[\"<b>Futex</b> [kernel/futex/]<br/>• Fast userspace mutexes<br/>• futex_wait_setup()<br/>• Acquires mmap_lock from MM\"]:::coreClass
 
 VFS[\"<b>VFS (File Descriptors)</b> [fs/file.c]<br/>• Shared fd table if CLONE_FILES\"]:::coreClass
 
 NS[\"<b>Namespaces</b> [kernel/nsproxy.c]<br/>• Process isolation / visibility\"]:::coreClass
 
 CGROUP[\"<b>CGroups</b> [kernel/cgroup/]<br/>• Resource enforcement\"]:::coreClass
 end

 %% --- LOW-LEVEL BOUNDARY ---
 subgraph LOW_LEVEL [\"Low-level Boundary\"]
 SCHED[\"<b>Scheduler Interface</b> [kernel/sched/core.c]<br/>• Receives sched_setaffinity() direct from Userspace<br/>• EEVDF — kernel >= 6.6 (Ubuntu 24.04)<br/>• CFS — kernel <= 6.1 (Debian 12)<br/>• CPU affinity & runqueue management\"]:::lowlevelClass
 
 MM[\"<b>Memory Manager</b> [mm/]<br/>• Receives copy_mm() call from Core<br/>• Allocates / duplicates mm_struct<br/>• Updates page tables & TLB<br/>• Provides mmap_lock to Futex\"]:::lowlevelClass
 end

 %% --- HARDWARE BOUNDARY ---
 subgraph ARCH_LAYER [\"Hardware Boundary (arch/x86/)\"]
 ARCH[\"<b>Architecture Layer (arch/x86/)</b><br/>• switch_to() — saves/restores CPU registers, swaps kernel stack (called from Scheduler)<br/>• switch_mm_irqs_off() — swaps CR3 page-table pointer during context switch (called from Memory Manager)\"]:::archClass
 end

 %% --- CONNECTIONS & FLOWS ---
 
 %% Syscall & Userspace Flow
 NPTL ===>|clone() / clone3() syscall| CORE
 CORE ===>|returns pid_t (TID)| NPTL
 
 %% Affinity Bypass Flow
 AFFINITY_SYS =======>|direct syscall — bypasses Core| SCHED
 
 %% Core Operations
 CORE --->|creates & enqueues tasks| SCHED
 
 %% Signal, Futex & MM Flow
 SIGNAL --->|signal wakeup| SCHED
 FUTEX --->|wake blocked thread| SCHED
 FUTEX --->|memory lock access (mmap_lock)| MM
 
 %% Downward Execution Steps
 SCHED ===>|context switch| ARCH
 MM ===>|page table switch| ARCH",
 "config": null

Futex [kernel/futex/core.c]
• futex_wait_setup() / hash bucket setup
• acquires mmap_lock from mm
• robust futex cleanup on thread death
• PI (priority inheritance) state teardown
• hrtimer-based timeout support
• v7.0: CONFIG_FUTEX_PRIVATE_HASH + CONFIG_FUTEX_MPOL

Signal Subsystem [kernel/signal.c]
• POSIX signal pipeline: create, queue, route, block/unblock
• interprets clone flags / signals to singular/group threads
• force_sig_fault() — hw faults → signals
• SA_RESTART / restart_block (interrupted syscalls)
• job control & ptrace integration
• exit_signals() — sets PF_EXITING
• alternate signal stacks
